welcomeEnabled.title: Welcome new viewers
welcomeEnabled.description: Show the existing Afterdark Brotherhood welcome notice when someone enters.

tipAcknowledgmentEnabled.title: Tip acknowledgment notices
tipAcknowledgmentEnabled.description: Enable or silence the automatic thank-you notice after tips. Tip tracking and VIP attribution continue either way.

loyaltyEnabled.title: Enable loyalty points
loyaltyEnabled.description: Master switch for daily visit, verified viewing, and meaningful-chat points. Existing balances and reward requests are preserved.

dailyVisitPoints.title: Daily visit points
dailyVisitPoints.description: Points awarded once per viewer per UTC day. Set to 0 to disable this earning source.

watchPointsPerFiveMinutes.title: Viewing points per 5 minutes
watchPointsPerFiveMinutes.description: Points for each complete five-minute room-viewing interval. Set to 0 to disable viewing rewards.

meaningfulChatPoints.title: Meaningful chat points
meaningfulChatPoints.description: Points for a qualifying message after its cooldown. Set to 0 to disable this earning source.

settingsHelp.title: Configuration guide
settingsHelp.description: These are native Chaturbate App V2 settings. Changes apply automatically; persistent viewer balances and room activity are not reset.
settingsHelp.default: Afterdark Brotherhood · No map. No supervision. Questionable decisions.

tipMenuDisplayEnabled.title: Show informational tip menu
tipMenuDisplayEnabled.description: Controls !tipmenu and !menu display. Existing menu items are preserved.

tipMenuTitle.title: Tip menu heading
tipMenuTitle.description: Custom heading shown above the existing menu items.

tipMenuFooter.title: Tip menu footer
tipMenuFooter.description: Short note shown below menu items. Leave blank for no footer.
tipMenuFooter.default: Tips are voluntary. Menu items are requests, not guaranteed outcomes. No game access or advantage is tied to tipping.

announcementIntervalMinutes.title: Announcement interval (minutes)
announcementIntervalMinutes.description: Used when rotating announcements are enabled. Minimum 5 minutes.

giveawayEnabled.title: Enable free giveaways
giveawayEnabled.description: Allows viewers to view and enter free giveaways. Disabling does not erase an active giveaway or its entries; broadcaster controls remain available.

viewerQueueEnabled.title: Enable viewer queue
viewerQueueEnabled.description: Allows viewers to join, leave, view, and book queue slots. Existing queue and bookings are preserved when disabled.

viewerQueueMaxWaitlist.title: Maximum waitlist size
viewerQueueMaxWaitlist.description: Caps the queue capacity. Existing stored entries are retained if the cap is lowered.
